source.document: The Basel Framework, consolidated PDF generated by the BIS website on 11/11/2026 (1429 pages), local file basel-framework-full.pdf (not committed)
source.read: 2026-11-19, text extracted with pypdf 6.21.3; formulas read from the embedded formula images

numbers: decimal strings (HR-12); percentages written as fractions

entries.value: EffEE_tk = max(EffEE_tk-1, EE_tk); EffEE_t0 = current exposure
[sum_{tk<=1y} EffEE_k dt_k df_k + sum_{tk>1y} EE_k dt_k df_k] / sum_{tk<=1y} EffEE_k dt_k df_k; cap 5 years (not applied for BA-CVA, MAR50.15(2))
1 year floor when all contracts < 1 year (CRE32.52-32.54 exceptions)

entries.note: more than 5000 trades at any point in a quarter, applies next quarter
more than two disputes in previous two quarters lasting longer than MPoR

entries.value: portfolio-level max of capital on Effective EPE (current) and on Effective EPE (stress calibration); not counterparty by counterparty
